text.en: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.

text.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ሲሄድ በገሊላና በሰማርያ መካከል አለፈ።
text.en: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.

text.am: ወደ አንዲት መንደርም ሲገባ በሩቅ የቆሙት አሥር ለምጻሞች ተገናኙት፤
text.en: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:

text.am: እነርሱም እየጮኹ። ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ አቤቱ፥ ማረን አሉ።
text.en: And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.

text.am: አይቶም። ሂዱ፥ ራሳችሁን ለካህናት አሳዩ አላቸው።
text.en: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.

text.am: እነሆም፥ ሲሄዱ ነጹ። ከእነርሱም አንዱ እንደ ተፈወሰ ባየ ጊዜ በታላቅ ድምፅ እግዚአብሔርን እያከበረ ተመለሰ፥
text.en: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,

text.am: እያመሰገነውም በእግሩ ፊት በግንባሩ ወደቀ፤ እርሱም ሳምራዊ ነበረ።
text.en: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.

text.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። አሥሩ አልነጹምን? ዘጠኙስ ወዴት አሉ?
text.en: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?

text.am: ከዚህ ከልዩ ወገን በቀር እግዚአብሔርን ሊያከብሩ የተመለሱ አልተገኙም አለ።
text.en: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.

text.am: እርሱንም። ተነሣና ሂድ፤ እምነትህ አድኖሃል አለው።
text.en: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.

text.am: ፈሪሳውያንም። የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት መቼ ትመጣለች ብለው ቢጠይቁት፥ መልሶ። የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት በመጠባበቅ አትመጣም፤
text.en: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:

text.am: ደግሞም። እንኋት በዚህ ወይም። እንኋት በዚያ አይሉአትም። እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት በመካከላችሁ ናትና አላቸው።
text.en: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.

text.am: ለደቀ መዛሙርቱም እንዲህ አለ። ከሰው ልጅ ቀኖች አንዱን ልታዩ የምትመኙበት ወራት ይመጣል አታዩትምም።
text.en: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.

text.am: እነርሱም። እነሆ በዚህ፥ ወይም። እነሆ በዚያ ይሉአችኋል፤ አትሂዱ አትከተሉአቸውም።
text.en: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.

text.am: መብረቅ በርቆ ከሰማይ በታች ካለ ከአንድ አገር ከሰማይ በታች ወዳለው ወደ ሌላ አገር እንደሚያበራ፥ የሰው ልጅ በቀኑ እንዲህ ይሆናል።
text.en: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.

text.am: አስቀድሞ ግን ብዙ መከራ እንዲቀበል ከዚህም ትውልድ እንዲጣል ይገባዋል።
text.en: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.

text.am: በኖኅ ዘመንም እንደ ሆነ፥ በሰው ልጅ ዘመን ደግሞ እንዲሁ ይሆናል።
text.en: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.

text.am: ኖኅ ወደ መርከብ እስከ ገባበት ቀን ድረስ፥ ይበሉና ይጠጡ ያገቡና ይጋቡም ነበር፥ የጥፋት ውኃም መጣ ሁሉንም አጠፋ።
text.en: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.

text.am: እንዲሁ በሎጥ ዘመን እንደ ሆነ፤ ይበሉ ይጠጡም ይገዙም ይሸጡም ይተክሉም ቤትም ይሠሩ ነበር፤
text.en: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;

text.am: ሎጥ ከሰዶም በወጣበት ቀን ግን ከሰማይ እሳትና ዲን ዘነበ ሁሉንም አጠፋ።
text.en: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.

text.am: የሰው ልጅ በሚገለጥበት ቀን እንዲሁ ይሆናል።
text.en: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.

text.am: በዚያም ቀን በሰገነት ያለ በቤቱ ያለውን ዕቃ ሊወስድ አይውረድ፥ እንዲሁም በእርሻ ያለ ወደ ኋላው አይመለስ።
text.en: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.

text.am: የሎጥን ሚስት አስቡአት።
text.en: Remember Lot's wife.

text.am: ነፍሱን ሊያድን የሚፈልግ ሁሉ ያጠፋታል፥ ነፍሱንም የሚያጠፋ ሁሉ በሕይወት ይጠብቃታል።
text.en: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.

text.am: እላችኋለሁ፥ በዚያች ሌሊት ሁለት ሰዎች በአንድ አልጋ ይሆናሉ፤ አንዱ ይወሰዳል ሁለተኛውም ይቀራል።
text.en: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

text.am: ሁለት ሴቶች በአንድ ወፍጮ ይፈጫሉ፤ አንዲቱ ትወሰዳለች ሁለተኛይቱም ትቀራለች።
text.en: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

text.am: ሁለት ሰዎች በእርሻ ይሆናሉ፤ አንዱ ይወሰዳል ሁለተኛውም ይቀራል።
text.en: Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

text.am: መልሰውም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወዴት ነው? አሉት። እርሱም። ሥጋ ወዳለበት በዚያ አሞራዎች ይሰበሰባሉ አላቸው።
text.en: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.

text.am: ሳይታክቱም ዘወትር ሊጸልዩ እንዲገባቸው የሚል ምሳሌን ነገራቸው፥
text.en: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;

text.am: እንዲህ ሲል። በአንዲት ከተማ እግዚአብሔርን የማይፈራ ሰውንም የማያፍር አንድ ዳኛ ነበረ።
text.en: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:

text.am: በዚያችም ከተማ አንዲት መበለት ነበረች፥ ወደ እርሱም እየመጣች። ከባላጋራዬ ፍረድልኝ ትለው ነበር።
text.en: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.

text.am: አያሌ ቀንም አልወደደም፤ ከዚህ በኋላ ግን በልቡ። ምንም እግዚአብሔርን ባልፈራ ሰውንም ባላፍር፥
text.en: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;

text.am: ይህች መበለት ስለምታደክመኝ ሁልጊዜም እየመጣች እንዳታውከኝ እፈርድላታለሁ አለ።
text.en: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.

text.am: ጌታም አለ። ዓመፀኛው ዳኛ ያለውን ስሙ።
text.en: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.

text.am: እግዚአብሔር እንኪያስ ቀንና ሌሊት ወደ እርሱ ለሚጮኹ ለሚታገሣቸውም ምርጦቹ አይፈርድላቸውምን?
text.en: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?

text.am: እላችኋለሁ፥ ፈጥኖ ይፈርድላቸዋል። ነገር ግን የሰው ልጅ በመጣ ጊዜ በምድር እምነትን ያገኝ ይሆንን?
text.en: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?

text.am: ጻድቃን እንደ ሆኑ በራሳቸው ለሚታመኑና ሌሎቹን ሁሉ በጣም ለሚንቁ ይህን ምሳሌ ነገራቸው፥
text.en: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:

text.am: እንዲህ ሲል። ሁለት ሰዎች ሊጸልዩ ወደ መቅደስ ወጡ፥ አንዱ ፈሪሳዊ ሁለተኛውም ቀራጭ።
text.en: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.

text.am: ፈሪሳዊም ቆሞ በልቡ ይህን ሲጸልይ። እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ እንደ ሌላ ሰው ሁሉ፥ ቀማኞችና ዓመፀኞች አመንዝሮችም፥ ወይም እንደዚህ ቀራጭ ስላልሆንሁ አመሰግንሃለሁ፤
text.en: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.

text.am: በየሳምንቱ ሁለት ጊዜ እጦማለሁ፥ ከማገኘውም ሁሉ አሥራት አወጣለሁ አለ።
text.en: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

text.am: ቀራጩ ግን በሩቅ ቆሞ ዓይኖቹን ወደ ሰማይ ሊያነሣ እንኳ አልወደደም፥ ነገር ግን። አምላክ ሆይ፥ እኔን ኃጢአተኛውን ማረኝ እያለ ደረቱን ይደቃ ነበር።
text.en: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.

text.am: እላችኋለሁ፥ ከዚያ ይልቅ ይህ ጻድቅ ሆኖ ወደ ቤቱ ተመለሰ፤ ራሱን ከፍ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ይዋረዳልና፥ ራሱን ግን የሚያዋርድ ከፍ ይላል።
text.en: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

text.am: እንዲዳስሳቸውም ሕፃናትን ደግሞ ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም አይተው ገሠጹአቸው።
text.en: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

text.am: ኢየሱስ ግን ሕፃናትን ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ። ሕፃናት ወደ እኔ ይመጡ ዘንድ ተዉአቸው አትከልክሉአቸውም፤ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እንደ እነዚህ ላሉት ናትና።
text.en: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

text.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት እንደ ሕፃን የማይቀበላት ሁሉ ከቶ አይገባባትም አለ።
text.en: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.

text.am: ከአለቆችም አንዱ። ቸር መምህር፥ የዘላለምን ሕይወት እንድወርስ ምን ላድርግ? ብሎ ጠየቀው።
text.en: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

text.am: ኢየሱስም። ስለ ምን ቸር ትለኛለህ? ከአንዱ ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር ቸር ማንም የለም።
text.en: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.

text.am: ትእዛዛቱን ታውቃለህ፥ አታመንዝር፥ አትግደል፥ አትስረቅ፥ በሐሰት አትመስክር፥ አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር አለው።
text.en: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.

text.am: እርሱም። ይህን ሁሉ ከሕፃንናቴ ጀምሬ ጠብቄአለሁ አለ።
text.en: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.

text.am: ኢየሱስም ይህን ሰምቶ። አንዲት ገና ቀርታሃለች፤ ያለህን ሁሉ ሽጠህ ለድሆች ስጥ፥ በሰማይም መዝገብ ታገኛለህ፥ መጥተህም ተከተለኝ አለው።
text.en: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.

text.am: እርሱ ግን ይህን ሰምቶ እጅግ ባለ ጠጋ ነበርና ብዙ አዘነ።
text.en: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.

text.am: ኢየሱስም ብዙ እንዳዘነ አይቶ። ገንዘብ ላላቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት መግባት እንዴት ጭንቅ ይሆናል።
text.en: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

text.am: ባለ ጠጋ ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ከሚገባ ይልቅ ግመል በመርፌ ቀዳዳ ሊገባ ይቀላል አለ።
text.en: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

text.am: የሰሙትም። እንግዲህ ማን ሊድን ይችላል? አሉ።
text.en: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?

text.am: እርሱ ግን። በሰው ዘንድ የማይቻል በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ይቻላል አለ።
text.en: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

text.am: ጴጥሮስም። እነሆ፥ እኛ ሁሉን ትተን ተከተልንህ አለ።
text.en: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.

text.am: እርሱም። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ስለ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ቤትን ወይም ወላጆችን ወይም ወንድሞችን ወይም ሚስትን ወይም ልጆችን የተወ፥
text.en: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,

text.am: በዚህ ዘመን ብዙ እጥፍ በሚመጣውም ዓለም የዘላለምን ሕይወት የማይቀበል ማንም የለም አላቸው።
text.en: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.

text.am: አሥራ ሁለቱንም ወደ እርሱ አቅርቦ እንዲህ አላቸው። እነሆ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንወጣለን፥ ስለ ሰው ልጅም በነቢያት የተጻፈው ሁሉ ይፈጸማል።
text.en: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.

text.am: ለአሕዛብ አሳልፈው ይሰጡታልና፥ ይዘብቱበትማል ያንገላቱትማል ይተፉበትማል፤
text.en: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:

text.am: ከገረፉትም በኋላ ይገድሉታል፥ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ይነሣል።
text.en: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.

text.am: እነርሱም ከዚህ ነገር ምንም አላስተዋሉም፥ ይህም ቃል ተሰውሮባቸው ነበር፥ የተናገረውንም አላወቁም።
text.en: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.

text.am: ወደ ኢያሪኮም በቀረበ ጊዜ አንድ ዕውር እየለመነ በመንገድ ዳር ተቀምጦ ነበር።
text.en: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:

text.am: ሕዝብም ሲያልፍ ሰምቶ። ይህ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ ጠየቀ።
text.en: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.

text.am: እነርሱም። የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ ያልፋል ብለው አወሩለት።
text.en: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.

text.am: እርሱም። የዳዊት ልጅ፥ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ማረኝ እያለ ጮኸ።
text.en: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

text.am: በስተ ፊት ይሄዱ የነበሩትም ዝም እንዲል ገሠጹት፤ እርሱ ግን። የዳዊት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ማረኝ እያለ አብዝቶ ጮኸ።
text.en: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

text.am: ኢየሱስም ቆሞ ወደ እርሱ እንዲያመጡት አዘዘ። በቀረበም ጊዜ። ምን ላደርግልህ ትወዳለህ? ብሎ ጠየቀው።
text.en: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,

text.am: እርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አይ ዘንድ ነው አለው።
text.en: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

text.am: ኢየሱስም። እይ፤ እምነትህ አድኖሃል አለው።
text.en: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜም አየ፥ እግዚአብሔንም እያከበረ ተከተለው። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አይተው እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገኑ።
text.en: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.

text.am: ወደ ኢያሪኮም ገብቶ ያልፍ ነበር። እነሆም ዘኬዎስ የሚባል ሰው፥ እርሱም የቀራጮች አለቃ ነበረ፥ ባለ ጠጋም ነበረ።
text.en: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.

text.am: ወደ ኢያሪኮም ገብቶ ያልፍ ነበር። እነሆም ዘኬዎስ የሚባል ሰው፥ እርሱም የቀራጮች አለቃ ነበረ፥ ባለ ጠጋም ነበረ።
text.en: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.

text.am: ኢየሱስንም የትኛው እንደ ሆነ ሊያይ ይፈልግ ነበር፤ ቁመቱም አጭር ነበረና ስለ ሕዝቡ ብዛት አቃተው።
text.en: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.

text.am: በዚያችም መንገድ ያልፍ ዘንድ አለውና ያየው ዘንድ ወደ ፊት ሮጦ በአንድ ሾላ ላይ ወጣ።
text.en: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.

text.am: ኢየሱስም ወደዚያ ስፍራ በደረሰ ጊዜ፥ አሻቅቦ አየና። ዘኬዎስ ሆይ፥ ዛሬ በቤትህ እውል ዘንድ ይገባኛልና ፈጥነህ ውረድ አለው።
text.en: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.

text.am: ፈጥኖም ወረደ በደስታም ተቀበለው።
text.en: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.

text.am: ሁሉም አይተው። ከኃጢአተኛ ሰው ጋር ሊውል ገባ ብለው አንጐራጐሩ።
text.en: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.

text.am: ዘኬዎስ ግን ቆሞ ጌታን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ካለኝ ሁሉ እኵሌታውን ለድሆች እሰጣለሁ፤ ማንንም በሐሰት ከስሼ እንደ ሆንሁ አራት እጥፍ እመልሳለሁ አለው።
text.en: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.

text.am: ኢየሱስም። እርሱ ደግሞ የአብርሃም ልጅ ነውና ዛሬ ለዚህ ቤት መዳን ሆኖለታል፤
text.en: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.

text.am: የሰው ልጅ የጠፋውን ሊፈልግና ሊያድን መጥቶአለና አለው።
text.en: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

text.am: እነርሱም ይህን ሲሰሙ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መቅረቡ ስለ ሆነ የእግዚአብሔርም መንግሥት ፈጥኖ ሊገለጥ እንዳለው ስለ መሰላቸው ምሳሌ ጭምር ተናገረ።
text.en: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.

text.am: ስለዚህም እንዲህ አላቸው። አንድ መኰንን ለራሱ መንግሥትን ይዞ ሊመለሰ ወደ ሩቅ አገር ሄደ።
text.en: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

text.am: አሥር ባሪያዎችንም ጠርቶ አሥር ምናን ሰጣቸውና። እስክመጣ ድረስ ነግዱ አላቸው።
text.en: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.

text.am: የአገሩ ሰዎች ግን ይጠሉት ነበርና። ይህ በላያችን ሊነግሥ አንወድም ብለው በኋላው መልክተኞችን ላኩ።
text.en: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.

text.am: መንግሥትንም ይዞ በተመለሰ ጊዜ፥ ገንዘብ የሰጣቸውን እነዚህን ባሪያዎች ነግደው ምን ያህል እንዳተረፉ ያውቅ ዘንድ እንዲጠሩለት አዘዘ።
text.en: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.

text.am: የፊተኛውም ደርሶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ምናንህ አሥር ምናን አተረፈ አለው።
text.en: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.

text.am: እርሱም። መልካም፥ አንተ በጎ ባሪያ፥ በጥቂት የታመንህ ስለ ሆንህ በአሥር ከተማዎች ላይ ሥልጣን ይሁንልህ አለው።
text.en: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.

text.am: ሁለተኛውም መጥቶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ምናንህ አምስት ምናን አተረፈ አለው።
text.en: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.

text.am: ይህንም ደግሞ። አንተም በአምስት ከተማዎች ላይ ሁን አለው።
text.en: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.

text.am: ሌላውም መጥቶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በጨርቅ ጠቅልዬ የጠበቅኋት ምናንህ እነሆ፤
text.en: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:

text.am: ፈርቼሃለሁና፥ ጨካኝ ሰው ስለ ሆንህ፤ ያላኖርኸውን ትወስዳለህ ያልዘራኸውንም ታጭዳለህ አለው።
text.en: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.

text.am: እርሱም። አንተ ክፉ ባሪያ፥ አፍህ በተናገረው እፈርድብሃለሁ። እኔ ያላኖርሁትን የምወስድና ያልዘራሁትን የማጭድ ጨካኝ ሰው እንደ ሆንሁ አወቅህ፤ ምን ነው ገንዘቤን ለለዋጮች አደራ ያልሰጠኸው?
text.en: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:

text.am: እኔም መጥቼ ከትርፉ ጋር እወስደው ነበር አለው።
text.en: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?

text.am: በዚያም ቆመው የነበሩትን። ምናኑን ውሰዱበት አሥሩ ምናን ላለውም ስጡት አላቸው።
text.en: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.

text.am: እነርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አሥር ምናን አለው አሉት።
text.en: And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)

text.am: እላችኋለሁ፥ ላለው ሁሉ ይሰጠዋል፥ ከሌለው ግን ያው ያለው ስንኳ ይወሰድበታል።
text.en: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.

text.am: ነገር ግን እነዚያን በላያቸው ልነግሥ ያልወደዱትን ጠላቶቼን ወደዚህ አምጡአቸው በፊቴም እረዱአቸው።
text.en: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.

text.am: ይህንም ከተናገረ በኋላ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሲወጣ ይቀድማቸው ነበር።
text.en: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.

text.am: ደብረ ዘይትም በሚባል ተራራ አጠገብ ወዳሉት ወደ ቤተ ፋጌና ወደ ቢታንያ በቀረበ ጊዜ፥ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለቱን ላከና።
text.en: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,

text.am: በፊታችሁ ወዳለችው መንደር ሂዱ፥ ወደ እርስዋም ገብታችሁ ከሰው ማንም ገና ያልተቀመጠበት ውርንጫ ታስሮ ታገኛላችሁ፥ ፈትታችሁም አምጡት።
text.en: Saying, Go ye into the village over against you; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither.

text.am: ማንም። ስለ ምን ትፈቱታላችሁ? ብሎ ቢጠይቃችሁ፥ እንዲሁ። ለጌታ ያስፈልገዋል በሉ አላቸው።
text.en: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.

text.am: የተላኩትም ሄደው እንዳላቸው አገኙ።
text.en: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.

text.am: እነርሱም ውርንጫውን ሲፈቱ ጌቶቹ። ውርንጫውን ስለ ምን ትፈቱታላችሁ? አሉአቸውም
text.en: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?

text.am: እነርሱም። ለጌታ ያስፈልገዋል አሉ።
text.en: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.

text.am: ወደ ኢየሱስም አመጡት፥ በውርንጫውም ላይ ልብሳቸውን ጭነው ኢየሱስን አስቀመጡት።
text.en: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.

text.am: ሲሄድም ልብሳቸውን በመንገድ ያነጥፉ ነበር።
text.en: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.

text.am: ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ቍልቍለትም አሁን በቀረበ ጊዜ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁላቸው ደስ እያላቸው ተአምራትን ሁሉ ስላዩ በታላቅ ድምፅ እግዚአብሔርን ሊያመሰግኑ ጀምረው።
text.en: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;

text.am: በጌታ ስም የሚመጣ ንጉሥ የተባረከ ነው፤ በሰማይ ሰላም በአርያምም ክብር አሉ።
text.en: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

text.am: ከሕዝብም መካከል ከፈሪሳውያን አንዳንዱ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርትህን ገሥጻቸው አሉት።
text.en: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.

text.am: መልሶም። እላችኋለሁ፥ እነዚህ ዝም ቢሉ ድንጋዮች ይጮኻሉ አላቸው።
text.en: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.

text.am: ሲቀርብም ከተማይቱን አይቶ አለቀሰላት፥
text.en: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,

text.am: እንዲህ እያለ። ለሰላምሽ የሚሆነውን በዚህ ቀን አንቺስ ስንኳ ብታውቂ፤ አሁን ግን ከዓይንሽ ተሰውሮአል።
text.en: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.

text.am: ወራት ይመጣብሻልና፥ ጠላቶችሽም ቅጥር ይቀጥሩብሻል ይከቡሻልም በየበኵሉም ያስጨንቁሻል፤
text.en: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,

text.am: አንቺንም በአንቺም ውስጥ የሚኖሩትን ልጆችሽን ወደ ታች ይጥላሉ፥ በአንቺ ውስጥም ድንጋይ በድንጋይ ላይ አይተዉም፥ የመጐብኘትሽን ዘመን አላወቅሽምና።
text.en: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.

text.am: ወደ መቅደስም ገብቶ በእርሱ የሚሸጡትን የሚገዙትንም ያወጣ ጀመር፤
text.en: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;

text.am: እርሱም። ቤቴ የጸሎት ቤት ይሆናል ተብሎ ተጽፎአል፤ እናንተ ግን የወንበዴዎች ዋሻ አደረጋችሁት አላቸው።
text.en: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.

text.am: ዕለት ዕለትም በመቅደስ ያስተምር ነበር፤ ነገር ግን የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎች የሕዝቡ ታላላቆችም ሊገድሉት ይፈልጉ ነበር፥
text.en: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,

text.am: የሚያደርጉበትንም አጡ፤ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሲሰሙት ተንጠልጥለውበት ነበርና።
text.en: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.

text.am: አንድ ቀንም ሕዝቡን በመቅደስ ሲያስተምር ወንጌልንም ሲሰብክላቸው፥ የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎች ከሽማግሌዎች ጋር ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡና።
text.en: And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,

text.am: እስኪ ንገረን፤ እነዚህን በምን ሥልጣን ታደርጋለህ ወይስ ይህን ሥልጣን የሰጠህ ማን ነው? ብለው ተናገሩት።
text.en: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?

text.am: መልሶም። እኔ ደግሞ አንዲት ነገር እጠይቃችኋለሁ፥ እናንተም ንገሩኝ፤
text.en: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:

text.am: የዮሐንስ ጥምቀት ከሰማይ ነበረችን ወይስ ከሰው? አላቸው።
text.en: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?

text.am: እርስ በርሳቸውም ሲነጋገሩ። ከሰማይ ብንል። ስለ ምን አላመናችሁበትም? ይለናል፤
text.en: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?

text.am: ከሰው ብንል ግን ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ይወግሩናል፤ ዮሐንስ ነቢይ እንደ ነበረ ሁሉ ያምኑ ነበርና አሉ።
text.en: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.

text.am: መልሰውም። ከወዴት እንደ ሆነ አናውቅም አሉት።
text.en: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.

text.am: ኢየሱስም። እኔም በምን ሥልጣን እነዚህን እንዳደርግ አልነግራችሁም አላቸው።
text.en: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

text.am: ይህንም ምሳሌ ለሕዝቡ ይላቸው ጀመር። አንድ ሰው የወይን አትክልት ተከለ ለገበሬዎችም አከራይቶ ለብዙ ዘመን ወደ ሌላ አገር ሄደ።
text.en: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.

text.am: በጊዜውም ከወይኑ አትክልት ፍሬ እንዲሰጡት አንድ ባሪያ ወደ ገበሬዎች ላከ፤ ገበሬዎቹ ግን ደበደቡት ባዶውንም ሰደዱት።
text.en: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.

text.am: ጨምሮም ሌላውን ባሪያ ላከ፤ እነርሱም ያን ደግሞ ደበደቡት አዋርደውም ባዶውን ሰደዱት።
text.en: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

text.am: ጨምሮም ሦስተኛውን ላከ፤ እነርሱም ይህን ደግሞ አቍሰለው አወጡት።
text.en: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.

text.am: የወይኑም አትክልት ጌታ። ምን ላድርግ? የምወደውን ልጄን እልካለሁ፤ ምናልባት እርሱን አይተው ያፍሩታል አለ።
text.en: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.

text.am: ገበሬዎቹ ግን አይተውት እርስ በርሳቸው ሲነጋገሩ። ወራሹ ይህ ነው፤ ርስቱ ለእኛ እንዲሆን ኑ እንግደለው አሉ።
text.en: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.

text.am: ከወይኑም አትክልት ወደ ውጭ አውጥተው ገደሉት። እንግዲህ የወይኑ አትክልት ጌታ ምን ያደርጋቸዋል?
text.en: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?

text.am: ይመጣል እነዚህንም ገበሬዎች ያጠፋል፥ የወይኑንም አትክልት ለሌሎች ይሰጣል። ይህንም በሰሙ ጊዜ። ይህስ አይሁን አሉ።
text.en: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.

text.am: እርሱ ግን ወደ እነርሱ ተመልክቶ። እንግዲህ። ግንበኞች የናቁት ድንጋይ እርሱ የማዕዘን ራስ ሆነ ተብሎ የተጻፈው ይህ ምንድር ነው?
text.en: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?

text.am: በዚያም ድንጋይ ላይ የሚወድቅ ሁሉ ይቀጠቀጣል፤ የሚወድቅበትን ሁሉ ግን ይፈጨዋል አለ።
text.en: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

text.am: የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎችም ይህን ምሳሌ በእነርሱ ላይ እንደ ተናገረ አውቀው በዚያች ሰዓት እጃቸውን ሊጭኑበት ፈለጉ ነገር ግን ሕዝቡን ፈሩ።
text.en: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.

text.am: ሲጠባበቁም ወደ ገዢ ግዛትና ሥልጣን አሳልፈው እንዲሰጡት ጻድቃን መስለው በቃሉ የሚያጠምዱትን ሸማቂዎች ሰደዱበት።
text.en: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.

text.am: ጠይቀውም። መምህር ሆይ፥ እውነትን እንድትናገርና እንድታስተምር ለሰው ፊትም እንዳታደላ እናውቃለን፥ በእውነት የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ ታስተምራለህ እንጂ፤
text.en: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truly:

text.am: ለቄሣር ግብር ልንሰጥ ተፈቅዶአልን? ወይስ አልተፈቀደም? አሉት።
text.en: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?

text.am: እርሱ ግን ተንኰላቸውንም ተመልክቶ። ስለ ምን ትፈትኑኛላችሁ? አንድ ዲናር አሳዩኝ፤
text.en: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?

text.am: መልኩ ጽሕፈቱስ የማን ነው? አላቸው። መልሰውም። የቄሣር ነው አሉት።
text.en: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.

text.am: እርሱም። እንኪያስ የቄሣርን ለቄሣር የእግዚአብሔርንም ለእግዚአብሔር አስረክቡ አላቸው።
text.en: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar's, and unto God the things which be God's.

text.am: በሕዝቡም ፊት በቃሉ ሊያጠምዱት አልቻሉም በመልሱም እየተደነቁ ዝም አሉ።
text.en: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.

text.am: ትንሣኤ ሙታንንም የሚክዱ ከሰዱቃውያን አንዳንዶቹ ቀርበው ጠየቁት፥
text.en: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,

text.am: እንዲህ ሲሉ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ሙሴ። ሚስት ያለችው የአንድ ሰው ወንድም ልጅ ሳይወልድ ቢሞት፥ ወንድሙ ሚስቱን አግብቶ ለወንድሙ ዘር ይተካ ብሎ ጻፈልን።
text.en: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

text.am: እንግዲያስ ሰባት ወንድማማች ነበሩ፤ የፊተኛውም ሚስት አግብቶ ልጅ ሳይወልድ ሞተ፤
text.en: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.

text.am: ሁለተኛውም አገባት፥ ሦስተኛውም፥ እንዲሁም ሰባቱ ደግሞ ልጅ ሳይተዉ ሞቱ።
text.en: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.

text.am: ሁለተኛውም አገባት፥ ሦስተኛውም፥ እንዲሁም ሰባቱ ደግሞ ልጅ ሳይተዉ ሞቱ።
text.en: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.

text.am: ከሁሉም በኋላ ሴቲቱ ደግሞ ሞተች።
text.en: Last of all the woman died also.

text.am: እንግዲህ ሰባቱ አግብተዋታልና ሴቲቱ በትንሣኤ ከእነርሱ ለማንኛቸው ሚስት ትሆናለች?
text.en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.

text.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። የዚህ ዓለም ልጆች ያገባሉ ይጋባሉም፥
text.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:

text.am: ያን ዓለምና ከሙታን ትንሣኤ ሊያገኙ የሚገባቸው እነዚያ ግን አያገቡም አይጋቡምም፥ እንደ መላእክት ናቸውና፥
text.en: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:

text.am: ሊሞቱም ወደ ፊት አይቻላቸውም፥ የትንሣኤም ልጆች ስለ ሆኑ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ናቸው።
text.en: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.

text.am: ሙታን እንዲነሡ ግን ሙሴ ደግሞ በቍጥቋጦው ዘንድ ጌታን የአብርሃም አምላክ የይስሐቅም አምላክ የያዕቆብም አምላክ በማለቱ አስታወቀ፤
text.en: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

text.am: ሁሉ ለእርሱ ሕያዋን ስለ ሆኑ፥ የሕያዋን አምላክ ነው እንጂ የሙታን አይደለም።
text.en: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.

text.am: ከጻፎችም አንዳንዶቹ መልሰው። መምህር ሆይ፥ መልካም ተናገርህ አሉት።
text.en: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.

text.am: ወደ ፊትም አንድ ነገር ስንኳ ሊጠይቁት አልደፈሩም።
text.en: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.

text.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። ክርስቶስ የዳዊት ልጅ ነው እንዴት ይላሉ?
text.en: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?

text.am: ዳዊትም ራሱ በመዝሙራት መጽሐፍ። ጌታ ጌታዬን። ጠላቶችህን ለእግርህ መርገጫ እስካደርግልህ ድረስ በቀኜ ተቀመጥ አለው ይላል።
text.en: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

text.am: ዳዊትም ራሱ በመዝሙራት መጽሐፍ። ጌታ ጌታዬን። ጠላቶችህን ለእግርህ መርገጫ እስካደርግልህ ድረስ በቀኜ ተቀመጥ አለው ይላል።
text.en: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

text.am: እንግዲህ ዳዊት። ጌታ ብሎ ይጠራዋል፥ እንዴትስ ልጁ ይሆናል?
text.en: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?

text.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ሲሰሙ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን።
text.en: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,

text.am: ረጃጅም ልብስ ለብሰው መዞር ከሚፈልጉ፥ በገበያም ሰላምታ፥ በምኵራብም የከበሬታ ወንበር፥ በምሳም የከበሬታ ስፍራ ከሚወዱ ከጻፎች ተጠበቁ፤
text.en: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;

text.am: የመበለቶችን ቤት የሚበሉ ጸሎታቸውንም በማስረዘም የሚያመካኙ፥ እነዚህ የባሰ ፍርድ ይቀበላሉ አለ።
text.en: Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.

text.am: ዓይኑንም አንሥቶ መባቸውን በመዝገብ የሚጥሉ ባለ ጠጎችን አየ።
text.en: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.

text.am: አንዲትም ድሀ መበለት ሁለት ሳንቲም በዚያ ስትጥል አየና።
text.en: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.

text.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ይህች ድሀ መበለት ከሁሉ ይልቅ አብልጣ ጣለች፤
text.en: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:

text.am: እነዚህ ሁሉ ከትርፋቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር መዝገብ ጥለዋልና፤ ይህች ግን ከጕድለትዋ የነበራትን ትዳርዋን ሁሉ ጣለች አለ።
text.en: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.

text.am: አንዳንዶቹም ስለ መቅደስ በመልካም ድንጋይና በተሰጠው ሽልማት እንዳጌጠ ሲነጋገሩ። ይህማ የምታዩት ሁሉ፥
text.en: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,

text.am: ድንጋይ በድንጋይ ላይ ሳይፈርስ በዚህ የማይቀርበት ዘመን ይመጣል አለ።
text.en: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

text.am: እነርሱም። መምህር ሆይ፥ እንግዲህ ይህ መቼ ይሆናል? ይህስ ይሆን ዘንድ እንዳለው ምልክቱ ምንድር ነው? ብለው ጠየቁት።
text.en: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?

text.am: እንዲህም አለ። እንዳትስቱ ተጠንቀቁ፤ ብዙዎች። እኔ ነኝ፥ ዘመኑም ቀርቦአል እያሉ በስሜ ይመጣሉና፤ እነርሱን ተከትላችሁ አትሂዱ።
text.en: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.

text.am: ጦርንና ሁከትንም በሰማችሁ ጊዜ አትደንግጡ፤ ይህ አስቀድሞ ይሆን ዘንድ ግድ ነውና፥ ነገር ግን መጨረሻው ወዲያው አይሆንም።
text.en: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ እንዲህ አላቸው። ሕዝብ በሕዝብ ላይ፥ መንግሥትም በመንግሥት ላይ ይነሣል፤
text.en: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:

text.am: ታላቅም የምድር መናወጥና በልዩ ልዩ ስፍራ ቸነፈር ራብም ይሆናል፤ የሚያስፈራም ነገር ከሰማይም ታላቅ ምልክት ይሆናል።
text.en: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.

text.am: ከዚህም ሁሉ በፊት እጃቸውን በላያችሁ ይጭናሉ ያሳድዱአችሁማል፤ ስለ ስሜም ወደ ምኵራብና ወደ ወኅኒ አሳልፈው ይሰጡአችኋል፥ ወደ ነገሥታትና ወደ ገዥዎችም ይወስዱአችኋል፤
text.en: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.

text.am: ይህም ለምስክርነት ይሆንላችኋል።
text.en: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.

text.am: ሰለዚህ እንዴት እንድትመልሱ አስቀድማችሁ እንዳታስቡ በልባችሁ አኑሩት፤
text.en: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:

text.am: ወደረኞቻችሁ ሁሉ ሊቃወሙና ሊከራከሩ የማይችሉትን አፍና ጥበብ እሰጣችኋለሁና።
text.en: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.

text.am: ወላጆችም ስንኳ ወንድሞችም ዘመዶችም ወዳጆችም አሳልፈው ይሰጡአችኋል፥ ከእናንተም አንዳንዱን ይገድላሉ፤
text.en: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.

text.am: በሁሉም ስለ ስሜ የተጠላችሁ ትሆናላችሁ።
text.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.

text.am: ከራሳችሁም አንዲት ጠጉር ስንኳ አትጠፋም፤
text.en: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.

text.am: በመታገሣችሁም ነፍሳችሁን ታገኛላችሁ።
text.en: In your patience possess ye your souls.

text.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ግን በጭፍራ ተከባ ስታዩ በዚያን ጊዜ ጥፋትዋ እንደ ቀረበ እወቁ።
text.en: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.

text.am: የዚያን ጊዜ በይሁዳ ያሉ ወደ ተራራዎች ይሽሹ፥ በመካከልዋም ያሉ ከእርስዋ ፈቀቅ ይበሉ፥ በገጠር ያሉም ወደ እርስዋ አይግቡ፤
text.en: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.

text.am: የተጻፈው ሁሉ እንዲፈጸም ይህ የበቀል ጊዜ ነውና።
text.en: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

text.am: በዚያን ወራት ለእርጕዞችና ለሚያጠቡ ወዮላቸው፤ ታላቅ ችግር በምድር ላይ፥ በዚህም ሕዝብ ላይ ቍጣ ይሆናልና፤
text.en: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.

text.am: በሰይፍ ስለትም ይወድቃሉ፤ ወደ አሕዛብ ሁሉም ይማረካሉ፤ የአሕዛብም ዘመን እስኪፈጸም ድረስ ኢየሩሳሌም በአሕዛብ የተረገጠች ትሆናለች።
text.en: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

text.am: በፀሐይና በጨረቃም በከዋክብትም ምልክት ይሆናል፤ በምድር ላይም አሕዛብ ከባሕሩና ከሞገዱም ድምፅ የተነሣ እያመነቱ ይጨነቃሉ፤
text.en: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;

text.am: ሰዎችም ከፍርሃትና በዓለም የሚመጣበትን ከመጠበቅ የተነሣ ይደክማሉ፤ የሰማያት ኃይላት ይናወጣሉና።
text.en: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜም የሰው ልጅ በኃይልና በብዙ ክብር በደመና ሲመጣ ያዩታል።
text.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

text.am: ይህም ሊሆን ሲጀምር ቤዛችሁ ቀርቦአልና አሻቅባችሁ ራሳችሁን አንሡ።
text.en: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.

text.am: ምሳሌንም ነገራቸው እንዲህ ሲል። በለስንና ዛፎችን ሁሉ እዩ፤
text.en: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;

text.am: ሲያቈጠቍጡ ተመልክታችሁ በጋ አሁን እንደ ቀረበ ራሳችሁ ታውቃላችሁ።
text.en: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.

text.am: እንዲሁ ደግሞ እናንተ ይህ ሁሉ መሆኑን ስታዩ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እንደ ቀረበች እወቁ።
text.en: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.

text.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ይህ ሁሉ እስኪሆን ድረስ ይህ ትውልድ አያልፍም።
text.en: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.

text.am: ሰማይና ምድር ያልፋሉ ቃሌ ግን አያልፍም።
text.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

text.am: ነገር ግን ልባችሁ በመጠጥ ብዛትና በስካር ስለ ትዳርም በማሰብ እንዳይከብድ፥ ያ ቀንም በድንገት እንዳይመጣባችሁ ለራሳችሁ ተጠንቀቁ፤
text.en: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.

text.am: በምድር ሁሉ ላይ በሚቀመጡ ሁሉ እንደ ወጥመድ ይደርስባቸዋልና።
text.en: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.

text.am: እንግዲህ ሊመጣ ካለው ከዚህ ሁሉ ለማምለጥ፥ በሰው ልጅም ፊት ለመቆም እንድትችሉ ስትጸልዩ ሁል ጊዜ ትጉ።
text.en: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.

text.am: ዕለት ዕለትም በመቅደስ ያስተምር ነበር፥ ሌሊት ግን ደብረ ዘይት ወደምትባል ተራራ ወጥቶ ያድር ነበር።
text.en: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.

text.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ይሰሙት ዘንድ ማልደው በመቅደስ ወደ እርሱ ይመጡ ነበር።
text.en: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.

text.am: ፋሲካም የሚባለው የቂጣ በዓል ቀረበ።
text.en: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.

text.am: የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎችም እንዴት እንዲያጠፉት ይፈልጉ ነበር፤ ሕዝቡን ይፈሩ ነበርና።
text.en: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.

text.am: ሰይጣንም ከአሥራ ሁለቱ ቍጥር አንዱ በነበረው የአስቆሮቱ በሚባለው በይሁዳ ገባ፤
text.en: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.

text.am: ሄዶም እንዴት አሳልፎ እንዲሰጣቸው ከካህናት አለቆችና ከመቅደስ አዛዦች ጋር ተነጋገረ።
text.en: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.

text.am: እነርሱም ደስ አላቸው፥ ገንዘብም ሊሰጡት ተዋዋሉ።
text.en: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.

text.am: እሺም አለ፥ ሕዝብም በሌለበት አሳልፎ እንዲሰጣቸው ምቹ ጊዜ ይፈልግ ነበር።
text.en: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.

text.am: ፋሲካንም ሊያርዱበት የሚገባው የቂጣ በዓል ደረሰ፤
text.en: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.

text.am: ጴጥሮስንና ዮሐንስንም። ፋሲካን እንድንበላ ሄዳችሁ አዘጋጁልን ብሎ ላካቸው።
text.en: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.

text.am: እነርሱም። ወዴት እናዘጋጅ ዘንድ ትወዳለህ? አሉት።
text.en: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?

text.am: እርሱም አላቸው። እነሆ፥ ወደ ከተማ ስትገቡ ማድጋ ውኃ የተሸከመ ሰው ይገናኛችኋል፤ ወደ ሚገባበት ቤት ተከተሉት፤
text.en: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.

text.am: ለባለቤቱም። መምህሩ። ከደቀ መዛሙርቴ ጋር ፋሲካን የምበላበት የእንግዳ ቤት ክፍል ወዴት ነው? ይልሃል በሉት፤
text.en: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

text.am: ያም በደርብ ላይ ያለውን የተነጠፈ ታላቅ አዳራሽ ያሳያችኋል፤ በዚያም አሰናዱልን።
text.en: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.

text.am: ሄደውም እንዳላቸው አገኙና ፋሲካን አሰናዱ።
text.en: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

text.am: ሰዓቱም በደረሰ ጊዜ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ ሐዋርያት ጋር በማዕድ ተቀመጠ።
text.en: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.

text.am: እርሱም። ከመከራዬ በፊት ከእናንተ ጋር ይህን ፋሲካ ልበላ እጅግ እመኝ ነበር፤
text.en: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:

text.am: እላችኋለሁና፥ በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እስኪፈጸም ድረስ፥ ወደ ፊት ከዚህ አልበላም አላቸው።
text.en: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

text.am: ጽዋንም ተቀበለ አመስግኖም። ይህን እንካችሁ በመካከላችሁም ተካፈሉት፤
text.en: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:

text.am: እላችኋለሁና፥ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እስክትመጣ ድረስ ከአሁን ጀምሮ ከወይኑ ፍሬ አልጠጣም አለ።
text.en: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.

text.am: እንጀራንም አንሥቶ አመሰገነ ቆርሶም ሰጣቸውና። ስለ እናንተ የሚሰጠው ሥጋዬ ይህ ነው፤ ይህን ለመታሰቢያዬ አድርጉት አለ።
text.en: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.

text.am: እንዲሁም ከእራት በኋላ ጽዋውን አንሥቶ እንዲህ አለ። ይህ ጽዋ ስለ እናንተ በሚፈሰው በደሜ የሚሆን አዲስ ኪዳን ነው።
text.en: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.

text.am: ነገር ግን አሳልፎ የሚሰጠኝ እጅ እነሆ በማዕድ ከእኔ ጋር ናት።
text.en: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.

text.am: የሰው ልጅስ እንደ ተወሰነው ይሄዳል፥ ነገር ግን አልፎ ለሚሰጥበት ለዚያ ሰው ወዮለት።
text.en: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!

text.am: ከእነርሱም ይህን ሊያደርግ ያለው ማን እንደ ሆነ እርስ በርሳቸው ይጠያየቁ ጀመር።
text.en: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.

text.am: ደግሞም ማናቸውም ታላቅ ሆኖ እንዲቈጠር በመካከላቸው ክርክር ሆነ።
text.en: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.

text.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። የአሕዛብ ነገሥታት ይገዙአቸዋል፥ በላያቸውም የሚሠለጥኑት ቸርነት አድራጊዎች ይባላሉ።
text.en: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.

text.am: እናንተ ግን እንዲህ አትሁኑ፤ ነገር ግን ከእናንተ ታላቅ የሆነ በመካከላችሁ እንደ ታናሽ፥ የሚገዛም እንደሚያገለግል ይሁን።
text.en: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.

text.am: በማዕድ የተቀመጠ ወይስ የሚያገለግል ማናቸው ታላቅ ነው? የተቀመጠው አይደለምን? እኔ ግን በመካከላችሁ እንደሚያገለግል ነኝ።
text.en: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.

text.am: ነገር ግን እናንተ በፈተናዎቼ ከእኔ ጋር ጸንታችሁ የኖራችሁ ናችሁ፤
text.en: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.

text.am: አባቴ እኔን እንደ ሾመኝ እኔ ደግሞ በመንግሥቴ ከማዕዴ ትበሉና ትጠጡ ዘንድ፥ በአሥራ ሁለቱ በእስራኤል ነገድ ስትፈርዱ በዙፋኖች ትቀመጡ ዘንድ ለመንግሥት እሾማችኋለሁ።
text.en: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;

text.am: አባቴ እኔን እንደ ሾመኝ እኔ ደግሞ በመንግሥቴ ከማዕዴ ትበሉና ትጠጡ ዘንድ፥ በአሥራ ሁለቱ በእስራኤል ነገድ ስትፈርዱ በዙፋኖች ትቀመጡ ዘንድ ለመንግሥት እሾማችኋለሁ።
text.en: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

text.am: ጌታም። ስምዖን ስምዖን ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ ሰይጣን እንደ ስንዴ ሊያበጥራችሁ ለመነ፤
text.en: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:

text.am: እኔ ግን እምነትህ እንዳይጠፋ ስለ አንተ አማለድሁ፤ አንተም በተመለስህ ጊዜ ወንድሞችህን አጽና አለ።
text.en: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.

text.am: እርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወደ ወኅኒም ወደ ሞትም ከአንተ ጋር ለመሄድ የተዘጋጀሁ ነኝ አለው።
text.en: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.

text.am: እርሱ ግን። ጴጥሮስ ሆይ፥ እልሃለሁ፥ እንዳታውቀኝ ሦስት ጊዜ እስክትክደኝ ድረስ ዛሬ ዶሮ አይጮኽም አለው።
text.en: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.

text.am: ደግሞም። ያለ ኮረጆና ያለ ከረጢት ያለ ጫማም በላክኋችሁ ጊዜ፥ አንዳች ጐደለባችሁን? አላቸው። እነርሱም። አንዳች እንኳ አሉ።
text.en: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.

text.am: እርሱም። አሁን ግን ኮረጆ ያለው ከእርሱ ጋር ይውሰድ፥ ከረጢትም ያለው እንዲሁ፤ የሌለውም ልብሱን ሽጦ ሰይፍ ይግዛ።
text.en: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.

text.am: እላችኋለሁና፥ ይህ። ከዓመፀኞች ጋር ተቈጠረ ተብሎ የተጻፈው በእኔ ሊፈጸም ግድ ነው፤ አዎን፥ ስለ እኔ የሚሆነው አሁን ይፈጸማልና አላቸው።
text.en: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.

text.am: እነርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ በዚህ ሁለት ሰይፎች አሉ አሉት። እርሱም። ይበቃል አላቸው።
text.en: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.

text.am: ወጥቶም እንደ ልማዱ ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ሄደ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ደግሞ ተከተሉት።
text.en: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.

text.am: ወደ ስፍራውም ደርሶ። ወደ ፈተና እንዳትገቡ ጸልዩ አላቸው።
text.en: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.

text.am: ከእነርሱም የድንጋይ ውርወራ የሚያህል ራቀ፥ ተንበርክኮም። አባት ሆይ፥
text.en: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,

text.am: ብትፈቅድ ይህችን ጽዋ ከእኔ ውሰድ፤ ነገር ግን የእኔ ፈቃድ አይሁን የአንተ እንጂ እያለ ይጸልይ ነበር።
text.en: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.

text.am: ከሰማይም መጥቶ የሚያበረታ መልአክ ታየው።
text.en: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.

text.am: በፍርሃትም ሲጣጣር አጽንቶ ይጸልይ ነበር፤ ወዙም በምድር ላይ እንደሚወርድ እንደ ደም ነጠብጣብ ነበረ።
text.en: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.

text.am: ከጸሎትም ተነሥቶ ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ መጣና ከኀዘን የተነሣ ተኝተው ሲያገኛቸው።
text.en: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,

text.am: ስለ ምን ትተኛላችሁ? ወደ ፈተና እንዳትገቡ ተነሥታችሁ ጸልዩ አላቸው።
text.en: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.

text.am: ገናም ሲናገር እነሆ፥ ሰዎች መጡ፤ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱም ይሁዳ የሚባለው ይቀድማቸው ነበር፥ ሊስመውም ወደ ኢየሱስ ቀረበ።
text.en: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.

text.am: ኢየሱስ ግን። ይሁዳ ሆይ፥ በመሳም የሰውን ልጅ አሳልፈህ ትሰጣለህን? አለው።
text.en: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?

text.am: በዙሪያውም የነበሩት የሚሆነውን ባዩ ጊዜ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በሰይፍ እንምታቸውን? አሉት።
text.en: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?

text.am: ከእነርሱም አንዱ የሊቀ ካህናቱን ባሪያ መትቶ ቀኝ ጆሮውን ቈረጠው።
text.en: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

text.am: ኢየሱስ ግን መልሶ። ይህንስ ፍቀዱ አለ፤ ጆሮውንም ዳስሶ ፈወሰው።
text.en: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.

text.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ እርሱ ለመጡበት ለካህናት አለቆችና ለመቅደስ አዛዦች ለሽማግሌዎችም። ወንበዴን እንደምትይዙ ሰይፍና ጐመድ ይዛችሁ ወጣችሁን?
text.en: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?

text.am: በመቅደስ ዕለት ዕለት ከእናንተ ጋር ስሆን እጆቻችሁን አልዘረጋችሁብኝም፤ ይህ ግን ጊዜያችሁና የጨለማው ሥልጣን ነው አላቸው።
text.en: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.

text.am: ይዘውም ወሰዱት ወደ ሊቀ ካህናት ቤትም አገቡት፤ ጴጥሮስም ርቆ ይከተለው ነበር።
text.en: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.

text.am: በግቢ መካከልም እሳት አንድደው በአንድነት ተቀምጠው ሳሉ ጴጥሮስ በመካከላቸው ተቀመጠ።
text.en: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.

text.am: በብርሃኑም በኩል ተቀምጦ ሳለ አንዲት ገረድ አየችውና ትኵር ብላ። ይህ ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ አለች።
text.en: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.

text.am: እርሱ ግን። አንቺ ሴት፥ አላውቀውም ብሎ ካደ።
text.en: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.

text.am: ከጥቂት ጊዜም በኋላ ሌላው አይቶት። አንተ ደግሞ ከእነርሱ ወገን ነህ አለው። ጴጥሮስ ግን። አንተ ሰው፥ እኔ አይደለሁም አለ።
text.en: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.

text.am: አንድ ሰዓትም የሚያህል ቆይቶ ሌላው አስረግጦ። እርሱ የገሊላ ሰው ነውና በእውነት ይህ ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ አለ።
text.en: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.

text.am: ጴጥሮስ ግን። አንተ ሰው፥ የምትለውን አላውቅም አለ። ያን ጊዜም ገና ሲናገር ዶሮ ጮኸ።
text.en: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.

text.am: ጌታም ዘወር ብሎ ጴጥሮስን ተመለከተው፤ ጴጥሮስም። ዛሬ ዶሮ ሳይጮኽ ሦስት ጊዜ ትክደኛለህ እንዳለው የጌታ ቃል ትዝ አለው።
text.en: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

text.am: ጴጥሮስም ወደ ውጭ ወጥቶ ምርር ብሎ አለቀሰ።
text.en: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.

text.am: ኢየሱስንም የያዙት ሰዎች ይዘብቱበትና ይደበድቡት ነበር፤
text.en: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.

text.am: ሸፍነውም ፊቱን ይመቱት ነበርና። በጥፊ የመታህ ማን ነው? ትንቢት ተናገር እያሉ ይጠይቁት ነበር።
text.en: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?

text.am: ሌላም ብዙ ነገር እየተሳደቡ በእርሱ ላይ ይናገሩ ነበር።
text.en: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.

text.am: በነጋም ጊዜ የሕዝቡ ሽማግሌዎችና የካህናት አለቆች ጻፎችም ተሰብስበው ወደ ሸንጎአቸው ወሰዱትና
text.en: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,

text.am: ክርስቶስ አንተ ነህን? ንገረን አሉት። እርሱ ግን እንዲህ አላቸው። ብነግራችሁ አታምኑም፤
text.en: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:

text.am: ብጠይቅም አትመልሱልኝም አትፈቱኝምም።
text.en: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.

text.am: ነገር ግን ከአሁን ጀምሮ የሰው ልጅ በእግዚአብሔር ኃይል ቀኝ ይቀመጣል።
text.en: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.

text.am: ሁላቸውም። እንግዲያስ አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህን? አሉት። እርሱም። እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ እናንተ ትላላችሁ አላቸው።
text.en: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.

text.am: እነርሱም። ራሳችን ከአፉ ሰምተናልና ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ምን ምስክር ያስፈልገናል? አሉ።
text.en: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.

text.am: ሁሉም በሞላው ተነሥተው ወደ ጲላጦስ ወሰዱትና።
text.en: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.

text.am: ይህ ሕዝባችንን ሲያጣምም ለቄሣርም ግብር እንዳይሰጥ ሲከለክል ደግሞም። እኔ ክርስቶስ ንጉሥ ነኝ ሲል አገኘነው ብለው ይከሱት ጀመር።
text.en: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.

text.am: ጲላጦስም። አንተ የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ነህን? ብሎ ጠየቀው። እርሱም መልሶ። አንተ አልህ አለው።
text.en: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.

text.am: ጲላጦስም ለካህናት አለቆችና ለሕዝቡ። በዚህ ሰው አንድ በደል ስንኳ አላገኘሁበትም አለ።
text.en: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.

text.am: እነርሱ ግን አጽንተው። ከገሊላ ጀምሮ እስከዚህ ድረስ በይሁዳ ሁሉ እያስተማረ ሕዝቡን ያውካል አሉ።
text.en: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.

text.am: ጲላጦስ ግን። ገሊላ ሲሉ በሰማ ጊዜ። የገሊላ ሰው ነውን? ብሎ ጠየቀ፤
text.en: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.

text.am: ከሄሮድስም ግዛት እንደ ሆነ ባወቀ ጊዜ ወደ ሄሮድስ ሰደደው፤ እርሱ ደግሞ በዚያ ጊዜ በኢየሩሳሌም ነበረና።
text.en: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.

text.am: ሄሮድስም ኢየሱስን ባየው ጊዜ እጅግ ደስ አለው፤ ስለ እርሱ ስለ ሰማ ከብዙ ጊዜ ጀምሮ ሊያየው ይመኝ ነበርና፥ ምልክትም ሲያደርግ ሊያይ ተስፋ ያደርግ ነበር።
text.en: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.

text.am: በብዙ ቃልም ጠየቀው፤ እርሱ ግን አንድ ስንኳ አልመለሰለትም።
text.en: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.

text.am: የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎችም አጽንተው ሲከሱት ቆመው ነበር።
text.en: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.

text.am: ሄሮድስም ከሠራዊቱ ጋር ናቀው ዘበተበትም፥ የጌጥ ልብስም አልብሶ ወደ ጲላጦስ መልሶ ሰደደው።
text.en: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.

text.am: ሄሮድስና ጲላጦስም በዚያን ቀን እርስ በርሳቸው ወዳጆች ሆኑ፥ ቀድሞ በመካከላቸው ጥል ነበረና።
text.en: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.

text.am: ጲላጦስም፥ የካህናትን አለቆችና መኳንንትን ሕዝቡንም በአንድነት ጠርቶ እንዲህ አላቸው።
text.en: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

text.am: ሕዝቡን ያጣምማል ብላችሁ ይህን ሰው ወደ እኔ አመጣችሁት፤ እነሆም፥ በፊታችሁ መርምሬ ከምትከሱበት ነገር አንድ በደል ስንኳ በዚህ ሰው አላገኘሁበትም።
text.en: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:

text.am: ሄሮድስም ደግሞ ምንም አላገኘም፤ ወደ እኛ መልሶታልና፤ እነሆም፥ ለሞት የሚያደርሰው ምንም አላደረገም፤
text.en: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.

text.am: እንግዲያስ ቀጥቼ እፈታዋለሁ። በበዓሉ አንድ ይፈታላቸው ዘንድ ግድ ነበረና።
text.en: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.

text.am: እንግዲያስ ቀጥቼ እፈታዋለሁ። በበዓሉ አንድ ይፈታላቸው ዘንድ ግድ ነበረና።
text.en: For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)

text.am: ሁላቸውም በአንድነት። ይህን አስወግድ፥ በርባንንም ፍታልን እያሉ ጮኹ፤
text.en: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:

text.am: እርሱም ሁከትን በከተማ አንሥቶ ሰውን ስለ ገደለ በወኅኒ ታስሮ ነበር።
text.en: Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)

text.am: ጲላጦስም ኢየሱስን ሊፈታ ወድዶ ዳግመኛ ተናገራቸው፤
text.en: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.

text.am: ነገር ግን እነርሱ። ስቀለው ስቀለው እያሉ ይጮኹ ነበር።
text.en: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.

text.am: ሦስተኛም። ምን ነው? ያደረገውስ ክፋት ምንድር ነው? ለሞት የሚያደርሰው በደል አላገኘሁበትም፤ ስለዚህ ቀጥቼ እፈታዋለሁ አላቸው።
text.en: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.

text.am: እነርሱ ግን እንዲሰቀል በታላቅ ድምፅ አጽንተው ለመኑት። የእነርሱ ጩኸትና የካህናት አለቆችም ቃል በረታ።
text.en: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.

text.am: ጲላጦስም ልመናቸው እንዲሆንላቸው ፈረደበት።
text.en: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.

text.am: ያንን የለመኑትንም፥ ስለ ሁከት ሰውንም ስለ መግደል በወኅኒ ታስሮ የነበረውን አስፈታላቸው፥ ኢየሱስን ግን ለፈቃዳቸው አሳልፎ ሰጠው።
text.en: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.

text.am: በወሰዱትም ጊዜ ስምዖን የተባለ የቀሬናን ሰው ከገጠር ሲመጣ ይዘው ከኢየሱስ በኋላ መስቀሉን እንዲሸከም ጫኑበት።
text.en: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.

text.am: ዋይ ዋይ ከሚሉና ሙሾ ከሚያወጡ ሴቶችና ከሕዝቡ እጅግ ብዙዎች ተከተሉት።
text.en: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.

text.am: ኢየሱስ ግን ወደ እነርሱ ዘወር ብሎ እንዲህ አለ። እናንተ የኢየሩሳሌም ልጆች፥ ለእኔስ አታልቅሱልኝ፤ ዳሩ ግን። መካኖችና ያልወለዱ ማኅፀኖች ያላጠቡ ጡቶችም ብፁዓን ናቸው የሚሉበት ጊዜ እነሆ ይመጣልና ለራሳችሁና ለልጆቻችሁ አልቅሱ።
text.en: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.

text.am: ኢየሱስ ግን ወደ እነርሱ ዘወር ብሎ እንዲህ አለ። እናንተ የኢየሩሳሌም ልጆች፥ ለእኔስ አታልቅሱልኝ፤ ዳሩ ግን። መካኖችና ያልወለዱ ማኅፀኖች ያላጠቡ ጡቶችም ብፁዓን ናቸው የሚሉበት ጊዜ እነሆ ይመጣልና ለራሳችሁና ለልጆቻችሁ አልቅሱ።
text.en: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ተራራዎችን። በላያችን ውደቁ፥ ኮረብቶችንም። ሰውሩን ይሉ ዘንድ ይጀምራሉ፤
text.en: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.

text.am: በእርጥብ እንጨት እንዲህ የሚያደርጉ ከሆኑ፥ በደረቀውስ እንዴት ይሆን?
text.en: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?

text.am: ሌሎችንም ሁለት ክፉ አድራጊዎች ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር ይገድሉ ዘንድ ወሰዱ።
text.en: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.

text.am: ቀራንዮም ወደሚባል ስፍራ በደረሱ ጊዜ፥ በዚያ እርሱን ክፉ አድራጊዎቹንም አንዱን በቀኝ ሁለተኛውንም በግራ ሰቀሉ።
text.en: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.

text.am: ኢየሱስም። አባት ሆይ፥ የሚያደርጉትን አያውቁምና ይቅር በላቸው አለ። ልብሱንም ተካፍለው ዕጣ ተጣጣሉበት።
text.en: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.

text.am: ሕዝቡም ቆመው ይመለከቱ ነበር። መኳንንቱም ደግሞ። ሌሎችን አዳነ፤ እርሱ በእግዚአብሔር የተመረጠው ክርስቶስ ከሆነ፥ ራሱን ያድን እያሉ ያፌዙበት ነበር።
text.en: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.

text.am: ጭፍሮችም ደግሞ ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው ሆምጣጤም አምጥተው።
text.en: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,

text.am: አንተስ የአሁድ ንጉሥ ከሆንህ፥ ራስህን አድን እያሉ ይዘብቱበት ነበር።
text.en: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.

text.am: ይህ የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ነው ተብሎ በግሪክና በሮማይስጥ በዕብራይስጥም ፊደል የተጻፈ ጽሕፈት ደግሞ በእርሱ ላይ ነበረ።
text.en: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

text.am: ከተሰቀሉት ከክፉ አድራጊዎቹም አንዱ። አንተስ ክርስቶስ አይደለህምን? ራስህንም እኛንም አድን ብሎ ሰደበው።
text.en: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.

text.am: ሁለተኛው ግን መልሶ። አንተ እንደዚህ ባለ ፍርድ ሳለህ እግዚአብሔርን ከቶ አትፈራውምን?
text.en: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?

text.am: ስለ አደረግነውም የሚገባንን እንቀበላለንና በእኛስ እውነተኛ ፍርድ ነው፤ ይህ ግን ምንም ክፋት አላደረገም ብሎ ገሠጸው።
text.en: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.

text.am: ኢየሱስንም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በመንግሥትህ በመጣህ ጊዜ አስበኝ አለው።
text.en: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.

text.am: ኢየሱስም። እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ ዛሬ ከእኔ ጋር በገነት ትሆናለህ አለው።
text.en: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.

text.am: ስድስት ሰዓትም ያህል ነበረ፥ ጨለማም እስከ ዘጠኝ ሰዓት በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ሆነ፥ ፀሐይም ጨለመ፥
text.en: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.

text.am: የቤተ መቅደስም መጋረጃ ከመካከሉ ተቀደደ።
text.en: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.

text.am: ኢየሱስም በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኾ። አባት ሆይ፥ ነፍሴን በእጅህ አደራ እሰጣለሁ አለ። ይህንም ብሎ ነፍሱን ሰጠ።
text.en: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.

text.am: የመቶ አለቃውም የሆነውን ነገር ባየ ጊዜ። ይህ ሰው በእውነት ጻድቅ ነበረ ብሎ እግዚአብሔርን አከበረ።
text.en: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.

text.am: ይህንም ለማየት ተከማችተው የነበሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ የሆነውን ባዩ ጊዜ፥ ደረታቸውን እየደቁ ተመለሱ።
text.en: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.

text.am: የሚያውቁቱ ግን ሁሉ ከገሊላ የተከተሉት ሴቶችም ይህን እያዩ በሩቅ ቆመው ነበር።
text.en: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.

text.am: እነሆም፥ በጎና ጻድቅ ሰው የሸንጎ አማካሪም የሆነ ዮሴፍ የሚባል ሰው ነበረ፤
text.en: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just:

text.am: ይህም በምክራቸውና በሥራቸው አልተባበረም ነበር፤ አርማትያስም ከምትባል ከአይሁድ ከተማ ሆኖ እርሱ ደግሞ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ይጠባበቅ ነበር።
text.en: The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.

text.am: ይኸውም ወደ ጲላጦስ ቀርቦ የኢየሱስን ሥጋ ለመነው፤
text.en: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.

text.am: አውርዶም በተልባ እግር ልብስ ከፈነው፥ ማንም ገና ባልተቀበረበት ከዓለትም በተወቀረ መቃብር አኖረው።
text.en: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.

text.am: የመዘጋጀት ቀንም ነበረ፤ ሰንበትም ሊጀምር ነበረ።
text.en: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.

text.am: ከገሊላም ከእርሱ ጋር የመጡት ሴቶች ተከትለው መቃብሩን ሥጋውንም እንዴት እንዳኖሩት አዩ።
text.en: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.

text.am: ተመልሰውም ሽቱና ቅባት አዘጋጁ። በሰንበትም እንደ ትእዛዙ ዐረፉ።
text.en: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.

text.am: ነገር ግን ከሳምንቱ በመጀመሪያው ቀን ያዘጋጁትን ሽቱ ይዘው ከእነርሱም ጋር አንዳንዶቹ ወደ መቃብሩ እጅግ ማልደው መጡ።
text.en: Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.

text.am: ድንጋዩንም ከመቃብሩ ተንከባሎ አገኙት፥
text.en: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.

text.am: ገብተውም የጌታን የኢየሱስን ሥጋ አላገኙም።
text.en: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.

text.am: እነርሱም በዚህ ሲያመነቱ፥ እነሆ፥ ሁለት ሰዎች የሚያንጸባርቅ ልብስ ለብሰው ወደ እነርሱ ቀረቡ፤
text.en: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:

text.am: ፈርተውም ፊታቸውን ወደ ምድር አቀርቅረው ሳሉ፥ እንዲህ አሉአቸው። ሕያውን ከሙታን መካከል ስለ ምን ትፈልጋላችሁ? ተነሥቶአል እንጂ በዚህ የለም።
text.en: And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?

text.am: የሰው ልጅ በኃጢአተኞች እጅ አልፎ ሊሰጥና ሊሰቀል በሦስተኛውም ቀን ሊነሣ ግድ ነው እያለ ገና በገሊላ ሳለ ለእናንተ እንደ ተናገረ አስቡ።
text.en: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,

text.am: የሰው ልጅ በኃጢአተኞች እጅ አልፎ ሊሰጥና ሊሰቀል በሦስተኛውም ቀን ሊነሣ ግድ ነው እያለ ገና በገሊላ ሳለ ለእናንተ እንደ ተናገረ አስቡ።
text.en: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.

text.am: ቃሎቹንም አሰቡ፥ ከመቃብሩም ተመልሰው ይህን ሁሉ ለአሥራ አንዱና ለሌሎች ሁሉ ነገሩአቸው።
text.en: And they remembered his words,

text.am: ቃሎቹንም አሰቡ፥ ከመቃብሩም ተመልሰው ይህን ሁሉ ለአሥራ አንዱና ለሌሎች ሁሉ ነገሩአቸው።
text.en: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.

text.am: ይህንም ለሐዋርያት የነገሩአቸው መግደላዊት ማርያምና ዮሐና የያዕቆብም እናት ማርያም ከእነርሱም ጋር የነበሩት ሌሎች ሴቶች ነበሩ።
text.en: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.

text.am: ይህም ቃል ቅዠት መስሎ ታያቸውና አላመኑአቸውም።
text.en: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.

text.am: ጴጥሮስ ግን ተነሥቶ ወደ መቃብር ሮጠ፤ በዚያም ዝቅ ብሎ ሲመለከት የተልባ እግር ልብስን ብቻ አየ፤ በሆነውም ነገር እየተደነቀ ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።
text.en: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.

text.am: እነሆም፥ ከእነርሱ ሁለቱ በዚያ ቀን ከኢየሩሳሌም ስድሳ ምዕራፍ ያህል ወደሚርቅ ኤማሁስ ወደሚባል መንደር ይሄዱ ነበር፤
text.en: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.

text.am: ስለዚህም ስለ ሆነው ነገር ሁሉ እርስ በርሳቸው ይነጋገሩ ነበር።
text.en: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.

text.am: ሲነጋገሩና ሲመራመሩም፥ ኢየሱስ ራሱ ቀርቦ ከእነርሱ ጋር ይሄድ ነበር፤
text.en: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.

text.am: ነገር ግን እንዳያውቁት ዓይናቸው ተይዞ ነበር።
text.en: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.

text.am: እርሱም። እየጠወለጋችሁ ስትሄዱ፥ እርስ በርሳችሁ የምትነጋገሩአቸው እነዚህ ነገሮች ምንድር ናቸው? አላቸው።
text.en: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?

text.am: ቀለዮጳ የሚባልም አንዱ መልሶ። አንተ በኢየሩሳሌም እንግዳ ሆነህ ለብቻህ ትኖራለህን? በእነዚህ ቀኖች በዚያ የሆነውን ነገር አታውቅምን? አለው።
text.en: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?

text.am: እርሱም። ይህ ምንድር ነው? አላቸው። እነርሱም እንዲህ አሉት። በእግዚአብሔርና በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ፊት በሥራና በቃል ብርቱ ነቢይ ስለ ነበረው ስለ ናዝሬቱ ስለ ኢየሱስ፤
text.en: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:

text.am: እርሱንም የካህናት አለቆችና መኳንንቶቻችን ለሞት ፍርድ እንዴት አሳልፈው እንደ ሰጡትና እንደ ሰቀሉት ነው።
text.en: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.

text.am: እኛ ግን እስራኤልን እንዲቤዥ ያለው እርሱ እንደ ሆነ ተስፋ አድርገን ነበር፤ ደግሞም ከዚህ ሁሉ ጋር ይህ ከሆነ ዛሬ ሦስተኛው ቀን ነው።
text.en: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.

text.am: ደግሞም ከእኛ ውስጥ ማልደው ከመቃብሩ ዘንድ የነበሩት አንዳንድ ሴቶች አስገረሙን፤
text.en: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;

text.am: ሥጋውንም ባጡ ጊዜ። ሕያው ነው የሚሉ የመላእክትን ራእይ ደግሞ አየን ሲሉ መጥተው ነበር።
text.en: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.

text.am: ከእኛም ጋር ከነበሩት ወደ መቃብር ሄደው ሴቶች እንደ ተናገሩት ሆኖ አገኙት፥ እርሱን ግን አላዩትም።
text.en: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.

text.am: እርሱም። እናንተ የማታስተውሉ፥ ነቢያትም የተናገሩትን ሁሉ ልባችሁ ከማመን የዘገየ፤
text.en: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:

text.am: ክርስቶስ ይህን መከራ ይቀበል ዘንድና ወደ ክብሩ ይገባ ዘንድ ይገባው የለምን? አላቸው።
text.en: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?

text.am: ከሙሴና ከነቢያት ሁሉ ጀምሮ ስለ እርሱ በመጻሕፍት ሁሉ የተጻፈውን ተረጐመላቸው።
text.en: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.

text.am: ወደሚሄዱበትም መንደር ቀረቡ፥ እርሱም ሩቅ የሚሄድ መሰላቸው።
text.en: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.

text.am: እነርሱ። ከእኛ ጋር እደር፥ ማታ ቀርቦአልና ቀኑም ሊመሽ ጀምሮአል ብለው ግድ አሉት፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር ሊያድር ገባ።
text.en: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.

text.am: ከእነርሱም ጋር በማዕድ ተቀምጦ ሳለ እንጀራውን አንሥቶ ባረከው፥ ቈርሶም ሰጣቸው፤
text.en: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.

text.am: ዓይናቸውም ተከፈተ፥ አወቁትም፤ እርሱም ከእነርሱ ተሰወረ።
text.en: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.

text.am: እርስ በርሳቸውም። በመንገድ ሲናገረን መጻሕፍትንም ሲከፍትልን ልባችን ይቃጠልብን አልነበረምን? ተባባሉ።
text.en: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?

text.am: በዚያችም ሰዓት ተነሥተው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ፥ አሥራ አንዱና ከእነርሱ ጋር የነበሩትም። ጌታ በእውነት ተነሥቶአል ለስምዖንም ታይቶአል እያሉ በአንድነት ተሰብስበው አገኙአቸው።
text.en: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,

text.am: በዚያችም ሰዓት ተነሥተው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ፥ አሥራ አንዱና ከእነርሱ ጋር የነበሩትም። ጌታ በእውነት ተነሥቶአል ለስምዖንም ታይቶአል እያሉ በአንድነት ተሰብስበው አገኙአቸው።
text.en: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.

text.am: እነርሱም በመንገድ የሆነውን እንጀራውንም በቈረሰ ጊዜ እንዴት እንደ ታወቀላቸው ተረኩላቸው።
text.en: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.

text.am: ይህንም ሲነጋገሩ ኢየሱስ ራሱ በመካከላቸው ቆሞ። ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን አላቸው።
text.en: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

text.am: ነገር ግን ደነገጡና ፈሩ መንፈስም ያዩ መሰላቸው።
text.en: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

text.am: እርሱም። ስለ ምን ትደነግጣላችሁ? ስለ ምንስ አሳብ በልባችሁ ይነሣል?
text.en: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?

text.am: እኔ ራሴ እንደ ሆንሁ እጆቼንና እግሮቼን እዩ፤ በእኔ እንደምታዩት፥ መንፈስ ሥጋና አጥንት የለውምና እኔን ዳስሳችሁ እዩ አላቸው።
text.en: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.

text.am: ይህንም ብሎ እጆቹንና እግሮቹን አሳያቸው።
text.en: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.

text.am: እነርሱም ከደስታ የተነሣ ገና ስላላመኑ ሲደነቁ ሳሉ። በዚህ አንዳች የሚበላ አላችሁን? አላቸው።
text.en: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?

text.am: እነርሱም ከተጠበሰ ዓሣ አንድ ቁራጭ፥ ከማር ወለላም ሰጡት፤
text.en: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.

text.am: ተቀብሎም በፊታቸው በላ።
text.en: And he took it, and did eat before them.

text.am: እርሱም። ከእናንተ ጋር ሳለሁ በሙሴ ሕግና በነቢያት በመዝሙራትም ስለ እኔ የተጻፈው ሁሉ ይፈጸም ዘንድ ይገባል ብዬ የነገርኋችሁ ቃሌ ይህ ነው አላቸው።
text.en: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜም መጻሕፍትን ያስተውሉ ዘንድ አእምሮአቸውን ከፈተላቸው፤
text.en: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,

text.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። ክርስቶስ መከራ ይቀበላል በሦስተኛውም ቀን ከሙታን ይነሣል፥
text.en: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:

text.am: በስሙም ንስሐና የኃጢአት ስርየት ከኢየሩሳሌም ጀምሮ በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ይሰበካል ተብሎ እንዲሁ ተጽፎአል።
text.en: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

text.am: እናንተም ለዚህ ምስክሮች ናችሁ።
text.en: And ye are witnesses of these things.

text.am: እነሆም፥ አባቴ የሰጠውን ተስፋ እኔ እልክላችኋለሁ፤ እናንተ ግን ከላይ ኃይል እስክትለብሱ ድረስ በኢየሩሳሌም ከተማ ቆዩ።
text.en: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.

text.am: እስከ ቢታንያም አወጣቸው እጆቹንም አንሥቶ ባረካቸው።
text.en: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.

text.am: ሲባርካቸውም ከእነርሱ ተለየ ወደ ሰማይም ዐረገ።
text.en: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.

text.am: እነርሱም፤ ሰገዱለትና በብዙ ደስታ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ፥
text.en: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:

text.am: ዘወትርም እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገኑና እየባረኩ በመቅደስ ኖሩ።
text.en: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
